note: Snapshot of SiYuan's own MCP tool catalog, used only until a live catalog is available. Refresh with: node bridge/mcp-stdio.mjs --dump-catalog > bridge/tools-snapshot.json

tools.description: Asset management. Actions: upload(id, files=comma-separated absolute paths), create_html(id, html, name?, parentID?, previousID?, nextID?), unused(), clean(path?), stat(path). create_html writes an HTML asset and inserts a sandboxed IFrame block in one operation.

html.description: HTML document content (for create_html, maximum 2 MiB)

name.description: HTML asset filename ending in .html or .htm (for create_html, default component.html)

notebook.description: Notebook ID that owns the target document; required for encrypted notebooks

parentID.description: Parent block ID (for create_html, defaults to the document ID)

path.description: Single unused asset path to remove, relative to data directory (for clean, optional). Use as returned by the unused action, e.g. assets/image/xxx.png.

tools.name: asset

tools.description: Block custom-attribute operations. Actions: get(id), set(id, attrs object), batch-get(ids comma-separated).

attrs.description:
Attribute key-value pairs (for set).
Common attributes:
- icon: emoji hex codepoint like "1f4ca", emoji character like "📊", custom image path like "1/b3log.png", network image URL like "https://example.com/icon.png", or dynamic icon URL like "api/icon/getDynamicIcon?type=8&color=%23d23f31&content=SiYuan&id=xxx"
- title-img: CSS format like 'background-image:url("assets/example.jpg")', NOT a bare asset path
- tags: comma-separated tag names

tools.name: attr

tools.description: Block operations. Actions: get(id), get_kramdown(id), get_children(id), tree_stat(id, by document), dom(id), insert(data, dataType, parentID?, nextID?, previousID?), append(data, dataType, parentID) / prepend(...) add a NEW child and return its ID — use after block.update when both modifying and adding, update(id, data, dataType, lockType?) replaces ONE block only (no append), delete(id), move(id, parentID, previousID?), breadcrumb(id), batch_get(ids) / batch_kramdown(ids) where ids is comma-separated.

data.description: Content in markdown or block DOM. Prefer markdown. A horizontal super-block uses {{{col with blank-line-separated child blocks and }}} on its own line; col is horizontal and row is vertical. Raw super-block DOM uses data-type="NodeSuperBlock" and data-sb-layout, never data-layout, and every child needs an explicit data-type. Markdown block references use ((blockID "anchor text")); never [[blockID]]

lockType.description: Reject update when the parsed block type differs from the existing block type; defaults to false

notebook.description: Notebook ID that owns the target blocks; required for encrypted notebooks

tools.name: block

tools.description: Bookmark management. Actions: list(), labels(), remove(label), rename(old, new).
tools.name: bookmark

tools.description: Daily note operations. Actions: create(notebook) — create/open today's note, append(notebook, data, dataType?) / prepend(...) add a block.

data.description: Content in markdown or dom (for append/prepend)

tools.name: dailynote

tools.description: Attribute view (database) operations. Every successful call returns {action, data}. Actions: create(parentID, name?, primaryKeyName?, layout=table, keys?, previousID?, nextID?), search(keyword), get(id), render(id, viewID?, query?, page=1, pageSize=50), keys(id), key_add(id, name, type, icon?, prev?), key_remove(id, keyID, removeRelationDest?), item_add(id, blockID?, content?, viewID?, groupID?, previousID?, detached?, ignoreDefaultFill?), item_remove(id, itemIDs), item_update(id, keyID, itemID, value), unused(), clean(id?). key_add appends to the current view when prev is omitted.

blockID.description: Block ID to bind (for item_add, optional)

content.description: Block column text content (for item_add, optional)

groupID.description: Group ID for positioning (for item_add, optional)

id.description: Attribute view ID (for get, render, keys, key_add, key_remove, item_add, item_remove, item_update, clean)

ignoreDefaultFill.description: Skip filling default values (for item_add, optional)

keys.description: Ordered fields to create after the primary key (for create, optional)

layout.description: Initial database layout (for create, default table)

name.description: Database name (for create) or key name (for key_add)

nextID.description: Next sibling block ID for positioning the new database (for create, optional)

notebook.description: Notebook ID that owns the new database; required for encrypted notebooks

parentID.description: Parent block ID for the new database (for create)

prev.description: Previous key ID for ordering (for key_add; omit to append)

previousID.description: Previous sibling database block (for create) or previous item (for item_add, optional)

primaryKeyName.description: Primary key field name (for create, optional)

removeRelationDest.description: Also remove related data in linked databases (for key_remove, optional)

tools.name: database

tools.description: Document operations. Actions: get(id), create(notebook, path=hPath, title, markdown?), list(notebook, path=hPath default /), delete(id), rename(id, title), move(id, notebook, path=target hPath), duplicate(id), search_docs(keyword), info(id).

notebook.description: Notebook ID (required for create, list, move)

path.description: Document hPath, the human-readable path shown in the document tree (e.g. /folder/doc). Used for create, list, move.

tools.name: document

tools.description: Export operations. Actions: md(id), html(id), preview(id), docx(id, output path), sy(id) → .sy.zip, md-zip(id), data() → full workspace backup.

id.description: Document block ID (for md, html, preview, docx, sy, md-zip)

output.description: Output file path (required for docx, optional for others)

tools.name: export

tools.description: Workspace file operations (paths relative to workspace; debugging/log reading only — never use for workspace data). Actions: list(path, limit=200, 0/-1=unlimited), read(path, offset, limit; default 200 lines, limit=-1 for full), write(path, data), delete(path), rename(old, new), copy(src, dst), grep(pattern, path, include?, context?, limit=200), find(path, include?, limit=200), stat(path).

context.description: Number of context lines before and after each match (for grep, default 0)

include.description: File glob pattern to filter files (for grep, find; e.g. "*.go", "*.{ts,tsx}")

limit.description: Maximum lines/files/entries to return (for read, list, find, grep). Default: 200 lines when offset and limit are both 0 for read, 200 for list/find/grep. Use 0 or negative for unlimited.

offset.description: Line number to start reading from (for read, 1-based). Negative means N lines from the end. Default: 0 (read from beginning).

path.description: Relative path within workspace (for list, read, write, delete, grep, find, stat)

pattern.description: Regex pattern to search for (for grep)

tools.name: file

tools.description: Document history operations. Actions: list(query?, notebook?, op?, type?, page?), search(query, notebook?, op?, type?, page?), get(path), rollback(path), clear().

path.description: History path relative to workspace directory (for get, rollback). Obtained from list/search output, e.g. history/2024-03-15-.../docid/...

tools.name: history

tools.description: Send an HTTP request to a REST API and return the raw text response (JSON is kept as-is). action (HTTP method): get (default)/post/put/delete/patch. url (http/https), headers (object), body (string). Use this instead of web_fetch when you need POST, custom headers (e.g. Authorization), or raw JSON responses.

url.description: The request URL (must start with http:// or https://)

tools.name: http_request

tools.description: List and understand local images referenced by a SiYuan document, or generate an image asset. Use list before analyze. analyze attaches the selected image to the current Agent model. generate creates a reusable image asset in the target document's notebook.

assetPath.description: Local assets/... path returned by list; required for analyze

documentID.description: Document or descendant block ID used to resolve the target document and notebook

prompt.description: Prompt describing the image to generate

question.description: Question for the current Agent model about the attached image

tools.name: image
tools.title: Document images

tools.description: Import operations (absolute local paths). Actions: md(notebook, path, targetPath?), sy(notebook, path, targetPath?) — .sy.zip, data(path) — full backup zip.

targetPath.description: Target internal filesystem path (for md, sy; default /). This is the ID-based path like /2022...ws.sy, not hPath.

tools.name: import

tools.description: Inbox management (cloud-clipped web pages, messages, and audio/video/file attachments; requires subscription). Actions: list(page=1), get(id), convert(ids, notebook, path=/, remove_after=true) — converts one or more shorthands into local documents under the target notebook, deleting the cloud originals on success.

path.description: Target hPath in the notebook for the new documents (default "/", the notebook root). Parent path must already exist.

remove_after.description: Whether to delete the cloud shorthand after a successful conversion (default true)

tools.name: inbox

tools.description: Notebook management. Actions: list(), open(id), close(id), create(name), rename(id, name), remove(id), set_icon(id, icon), random_icon(id?).

icon.description: Notebook icon (for set_icon). Emoji hex codepoint like "1f4ca", emoji character like "📊", custom image path like "1/b3log.png", network image URL like "https://example.com/icon.png", or dynamic icon URL like "api/icon/getDynamicIcon?type=8&color=%23d23f31&content=SiYuan&id=xxx"

id.description: Notebook ID (for open, close, rename, remove, set_icon, random_icon)

tools.name: notebook

tools.description: Document outline (heading tree). Action: get(id).
tools.name: outline

tools.description: Reference/backlink operations. Actions: backlinks(id, keyword?, sort?), mentions(id, keyword?, sort?), refresh(id).

sort.description: Sort mode for backlinks and mentions: 0=updated-desc 1=updated-asc 2=created-desc 3=created-asc 4=name-desc 5=name-asc 6=alphanum-desc 7=alphanum-asc (default 0)

tools.name: ref

tools.description: Repository (data snapshot) operations. Actions: list(tag?, page=1), create(memo?), tag(id, name), untag(name), checkout(id), diff(left, right), search(keyword, page?), purge(), file_get(id), file_rollback(id), file_open(id), file_export(id).

id.description: Snapshot ID (for tag, checkout, file_get, file_rollback, file_open, file_export)

tag.description: List tagged snapshots only (for list, optional)

tools.name: repo

tools.description: Search. Actions: fulltext(query, page=1, pageSize=20, notebook?, path?, type?, subtype?, method?, orderBy?, groupBy?), semantic(query, page=1, pageSize=20, notebook?, path?, type?, subtype?) — semantic needs AI embedding configured; asset(query, page=1, pageSize=32, ext?, method?, orderBy?) — full-text search inside asset file contents (PDF/Word/Excel/txt etc.), returns matched snippets with <mark> tags; getasset(path) — get the full indexed content of one asset file by its path (e.g. 'assets/foo.pdf').

action.description: Operation: fulltext, semantic, asset, or getasset

ext.description: Comma-separated asset file extensions to filter, e.g. 'pdf,docx,xlsx' (optional, asset only)

notebook.description: Comma-separated notebook IDs to filter (optional, fulltext/semantic only)

pageSize.description: Results per page (default 20 for fulltext/semantic, 32 for asset)

path.description: Comma-separated path prefixes to filter (optional, fulltext/semantic only); for getasset, a single asset file path like 'assets/foo.pdf'

subtype.description: Comma-separated block subtypes to filter, e.g. 'o,u,t' (optional, fulltext/semantic only)

type.description: Comma-separated block types to filter, e.g. 'document,heading,paragraph' (optional, fulltext/semantic only)

tools.name: search

tools.description:
Skill operations: load(name) loads Skill instructions; load(name/resource-path) loads a bundled text resource; save(name, content), install(url), remove(name), rename(name, new_name), list().

No skills are currently available.

content.description: SKILL.md full content with YAML frontmatter (for save)

name.description: Skill name. For load, use <skill-name> for instructions or <skill-name>/<relative-resource-path> for a bundled text resource

url.description: Skill source for install: 'owner/repo' shorthand (e.g. Tencent/WeChatReading), a full GitHub URL, a raw SKILL.md URL, or a release zip URL

tools.name: skill

tools.description: Read-only SQL on SiYuan's database. Action: query(stmt) — SELECT only. Results default to at most 100 rows; use explicit LIMIT and OFFSET clauses for pagination.

notebook.description: Optional notebook ID used to query an encrypted notebook

stmt.description: SQL SELECT statement. Results default to at most 100 rows; use LIMIT and OFFSET for pagination

tools.name: sql

tools.description: Data sync operations. Actions: perform() (full upload+download), upload(), download(), status().
tools.name: sync

tools.description: System info. Actions: version(), current_time(), workspace().
tools.name: system

tools.description: Tag management. Actions: list(keyword?), rename(old, new), remove(label).
tools.name: tag

tools.description: Template management. Actions: search(keyword?), get(path), remove(path), render(path, id), save_as(id, name, overwrite?), create(name, content, overwrite?).

keyword.description: Search keyword; empty lists all (for search)

name.description: Template name without extension (for save_as, create)

overwrite.description: Overwrite if exists (for save_as, create, default false)

path.description: Template file path as returned by search (for get, remove, render)

tools.name: template

tools.description: Extract a zip archive within the workspace. Provide the workspace-relative path to the zip file and the destination directory (also workspace-relative). The destination will be created if it does not exist.

destPath.description: Workspace-relative destination directory to extract into.

zipPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the .zip file to extract.

tools.name: unzip

tools.description: Fetch a web page and convert to Markdown or text. url (http/https), format: markdown (default) or text.

url.description: The page URL to fetch (must start with http:// or https://)

tools.name: web_fetch

tools.description: Web search via Exa, returns text results. Action: query(keywords).
tools.name: web_search

tools.description: Workspace management. Actions: list(), info() (path, version, valid).
tools.name: workspace
